# hestiacp_web_domain_alias (Resource)

Manages a web domain alias (parked domain) in HestiaCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Alias domain name, e.g. `www.example.com`.
- `domain` (String) Primary web domain the alias is attached to.

### Optional

- `user` (String) HestiaCP username. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
